sections.heading: tyConvexHullModifier
sections.content: ThetyConvexHullmodifier allows you to transform an object’s mesh into its convex hull, or a decompose a spline object’s polygons into convex hulls.

sections.heading: Convex Hull
sections.content:
Mode: mesh mode converts an object’s mesh into a convex hull - spline mode decomposes a spline’s polygons into convex hull polygons.Inflate: the amount to inflate resulting convex hulls by pushing the hull vertices along their normals.Split elements: when enabled, a convex hull will be generated for each mesh element. When disabled, all mesh elements will be transformed into a single convex hull.

Mode: mesh mode converts an object’s mesh into a convex hull - spline mode decomposes a spline’s polygons into convex hull polygons.

Inflate: the amount to inflate resulting convex hulls by pushing the hull vertices along their normals.

Split elements: when enabled, a convex hull will be generated for each mesh element. When disabled, all mesh elements will be transformed into a single convex hull.
